    Representations of thin ray categories #

    A representation of a thin ray category ThinCat T is a family of vector spaces sp x with maps map x y : sp x → sp y for le x y, compatible with composition (map y z ∘ map x y = map x z if the composite is nonzero, 0 otherwise). Its total space is a module over the linearization (RayCat.ThinRep.Tot). A module map between total spaces is given by its vertex components, which commute with the maps (RayCat.ThinRep.comp_map); this reduces brick and isomorphism questions to linear algebra.

    Type (u + 1)

    A representation of ThinCat T.

    • sp : V → ModuleCat k
    • map (x y : V) : T.le x y → ↑(self.sp x) →ₗ[k] ↑(self.sp y)
    • map_id (x : V) : self.map x x ⋯ = LinearMap.id
    • map_comp (x y z : V) (h : T.le x y) (h' : T.le y z) : self.map y z h' ∘ₗ self.map x y h = if hn : T.nz x y z then self.map x z ⋯ else 0

                    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ThinRep.not_isRepresentationFinite {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {T : ThinData V} {k : Type u} [Field k] {α : Type u_1} [Infinite α] (R : α → ThinRep T k) (hfin : ∀ (t : α) (x : V), FiniteDimensional k ↑((R t).sp x)) (hnt : ∀ (t : α), ∃ (x : V), Nontrivial ↑((R t).sp x)) (hend : ∀ (t : α) (f : (x : V) → ↑((R t).sp x) →ₗ[k] ↑((R t).sp x)), IsNatural f → ∃ (c : k), ∀ (x : V), f x = c • LinearMap.id) (hiso : ∀ (t t' : α) (f : (x : V) → ↑((R t).sp x) →ₗ[k] ↑((R t').sp x)), IsNatural f → (∀ (x : V), Function.Bijective ⇑(f x)) → t = t') :
                    ¬Statement.IsRepresentationFinite (RayQuiver.Linearization (ThinCat T) k)

                    Representation-infiniteness from a family of thin bricks. If an infinite family of finite-dimensional representations has scalar natural endomorphisms and members related by a natural family of bijections are equal, the linearization is representation-infinite.
